review_policy.label_error_meaning: The scoped present/not_observed assessment is not supported by the supplied pseudo-C.
review_policy.evidence_error_meaning: The target finding does not expose the target-CWE relation needed to teach or justify the assessment.

decisions.notes: CWE-127 present pseudo-C and target expose only a decompiler loop and printWLine(dest); the claimed buffer-underread boundary is not recoverable from the supplied representation.
CWE-762 not_observed function was optimized to return; only, so no allocator/deallocator matching evidence remains.
CWE-121 present target includes the oversized source initialization but omits swprintf(dest,__n,...) into the 50-element destination.
CWE-590 not_observed target cites delete and an initialized write but omits the matching operator_new allocation that proves the pointer is heap-backed.
CWE-457 not_observed target cites null checks and the read but omits the visible *puVar1 = _LCPI*_0 initialization.
CWE-124 not_observed target cites writes only and omits the 100-byte allocation boundary that makes those fixed offsets non-underwriting.
